Name: Giant Fern Fronds
Author: AirynS
Description:
[size=3]I've always thought that the giant fiddlehead fern trees that grow on green rain days should have been giant fern leaves instead. So I made it happen.[/size]

[b][size=5]INSTALLATION[/size][/b]

[size=3]To install, simply extract the "[CP] Giant Fern Fronds" folder and drop it into your Mods folder.[/size]

[size=5][b]CONFIGURATION[/b][/size]

[size=3]Giant Fern Fronds has one config option, WinterColour, which toggles whether the giant ferns will use the vanilla pale green colour in winter or a light brown instead. By default, giant ferns will turn into stumps in winter, so you'll need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24029]No Stump Winter Trees[/url] or another similar mod to see them in full.[/size]

Manifest.Name: Giant Fern Fronds
Manifest.Description: Edits the green rain fern tree to be a frond instead of a curled head.
